---
title: "Internals (Rust backend)"
---

Both packages wrap a Rust core via [extendr](https://extendr.github.io/).
The Rust modules implement the numerically intensive routines (matrix
construction, MCMC sampling, REML iteration).

- [masreml — Rust modules](masreml-rust.qmd)
- [masbayes — Rust modules](masbayes-rust.qmd)
